description: DATE_PART with the epoch family, both as a bare keyword (Snowflake's usual spelling) and quoted. The bare form - DATE_PART(epoch_second, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) - previously failed with "Column not found: epoch_second" because the epoch units were absent from the bareword-keyword whitelist. EPOCH is a synonym of EPOCH_SECOND, and the millisecond, microsecond and nanosecond forms scale from the same instant (DATE_PART treats the value as UTC, so 2024-01-01 00:00:00 is 1704067200 s). Converted from functions/DatePartEpochTest, which is trimmed to the one test comparing the engine's epoch against the host clock - an out-of-band reading with no SQL surface.
